ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Asahi Songwon Colors Limited has announced a final dividend of Rs. 1.50 per equity share for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The record date for determining eligible shareholders is September 23, 2026, with the dividend subject to approval at the Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. This is a routine corporate action demonstrating a commitment to shareholder returns and presents no immediate red flags, despite the standard AGM approval contingency.
